claim: The Fixtures section says `happy_path/` is "changeset.json + expected_receipts.json + verify.sh. It seeds nothing." — but the same leaf's "Full happy path" scenario requires pre-existing tracker state (a task to close, and a *finished* predecessor for the modified node) that only a seed can establish. The same section also describes `integration/export/` as "seed.sh + expected_tasks.json", and the leaf's own Harness sketch has a branch that diffs `tasks.json` against `expected_tasks.json` for that case. The "Export against a live sandbox" scenario instructs running `scripts/export-br.sh tasks.json` (the documented `$1` output-path form).
authoritative_source: The implementation actually shipped for this bead: `happy_path/` carries a `seed.sh` (the only way to satisfy the scenario's precondition of an existing task-to-close and a finished predecessor), and `integration/export/` carries `seed.sh` + `verify.sh` with no `expected_tasks.json`, run via `./export-br.sh > tasks.json` (stdout form) rather than the `$1` form.
evidence: Three separate defects in the leaf, all in the same section: (1) the Fixtures line "It seeds nothing" is flatly false against the scenario immediately above it, which cannot be satisfied without seeding; (2) the leaf's own Harness sketch (`if [[ -f expected_tasks.json ]]; then ./export-br.sh > tasks.json; diff ... expected_tasks.json; fi`) is unreachable for the export fixture because real `br` assigns non-deterministic task ids — an `expected_tasks.json` comparison against live `br` output cannot be exact-matched, which is exactly why the shipped fixture uses `verify.sh` instead and the actually-implemented harness (`scripts/apply-br_test.sh`) has no `expected_tasks.json` comparison branch at all; (3) because the export fixture uses `verify.sh` (which calls the script with stdout redirection) rather than the `expected_tasks.json` branch, `export-br.sh`'s documented `$1` positional-output-path form — the exact form the scenario text prescribes — is exercised by no test in this suite.
proposed_fix: Update the Fixtures section: `happy_path/` is "changeset.json + expected_receipts.json + seed.sh + verify.sh — the seed establishes the pre-existing task-to-close and finished predecessor the happy-path scenario requires." `integration/export/` is "seed.sh + verify.sh — verify.sh checks the export against the live listing directly, since real br's non-deterministic task ids make an expected_tasks.json exact-diff unreachable." Either drop the `expected_tasks.json` branch from the Harness sketch (since no fixture in this suite exercises it) or add a fixture that does. Optionally add a coverage note that `export-br.sh`'s `$1` output-path form is exercised only by the mock-mode export suite, not by the integration suite.
